_drive_supervision_source: Mirrors the Rosie 1430 cells' machine configuration drive_supervision (previous values from the brake_opening_guard timeout and the 1430 limits.following_error); unverified, issue #158.
_tracking_lag_allowance_source: Mirrors the Rosie 1430 cells' machine configuration tracking_lag_allowance (~27 ms lag measured on Rosie 1430 stop dumps 2026-10-06; 50 ms is the owner's chosen margin); unverified, issue #158.
_jog_jerk_source: One jerk for all six joints: rtctl sizes one smoothing window N = ceil(2 x a_max / jerk / cycle) = ceil(2 x 4*pi / 150 / 0.001) = 168 cycles (a_max = the description's 4*pi rad/s^2 jog/trajectory acceleration on every joint), so every jog start, EndJog, input expiry and Halt ramp keeps acceleration <= 4*pi rad/s^2 and jerk <= 150 rad/s^3 (75 rad/s^3 for a start or stop from steady speed). 168 ms spans one period of the ~5.9 Hz J4 ringing on the Rosie 1430 stop dumps 2026-10-06 (velocity sign changes every 82-85 ms after the 17:40:06 stop), where jog acceleration was 720 deg/s^2 reached in one 1 ms cycle. Cost: a stop from v takes 168 ms longer and travels v x 0.084 s further (0.07 rad at 0.8 rad/s). Unverified on the arm (issue #158): measure J4 ringing and stopping distance before changing it.
